hero._about: blender_apply.py --hero: per retime key, where its delta from the AI pose comes from. pose = a hand-posed hero key (art/rosace/poses/...); carry = reuse another key's delta (the AI's own motion rides on the authored extreme); mix = weighted blend of hero deltas; absent = pure AI. plants = frame spans where a foot is locked on the spot a hero key puts it (0 drift by construction). Round 3: blend = an absolute mix of other keys' states (the AI's own in-between ignored), for exact slow-in spacing; glaive = the weapon in world (hero_layer.py 'weapon in world').

smear._about: smear.py: tracked blade smears on strike drawings.
